## Round 2 at `ba4afcc2` (part 1 of 2) — Tier 1 rerun + the items #24518 / #24532 touch

Records: #24598 `tier1:automated-pins` (149/166 · 60 PASS / 89 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 17 NOT-RUN); #24605, #24607, #24608, #24609 PASS; #24606 FAIL → extracted as #24613 (pre-existing — the production code it exercises did not change between `5b14b7f3` and `ba4afcc2`; round 1's fixture never reached that path).

**Regression check:** no Tier 1 item went PASS → FAIL against `5b14b7f3`. The 81 verdict differences are scope (round 1 hand-drove Tier 2 clauses; this run reads pins only). Round 1's red-row dispositions carry forward unchanged.

### Checklist-accuracy findings (add to §3)

- `records-forms.object-hook-lifecycle`: step 1's route `/meta/types/hook` answers 404 — the route is `/meta/hook`; acceptance[8] answers `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` live, with the class name only in the server log; the steps' `$select` — the by-id read door accepts `select` only.
- `automation.flow-run-semantics-v18`: acceptance[1]'s fixture should name the contributor persona.
- `platform-core.boot-health`: the `check-console-injection` replay line still says "not the published one".
- `cli.scaffold-console-first-paint`: the pre-release variant needs a local verdaccio, which the item does not say.
- Tier 1 `automated.ref` quality: some refs name source files rather than tests (`hook-wrappers` / `hook-binder`); ~25 refs are bare file lists that over-claim clause coverage (e.g. `flow-node-type-matrix`, `trigger-type-matrix`, `crud-roundtrip`, `connector-declarative-boot`, `scope-depth-asymmetry`) — say which clauses each pin covers, or the next sweep cannot tell Tier 1 from Tier 2.

### Runner environment facts (add to §6)

- `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly` makes `packages/cli` select only the nightly tier — 28 of 29 files ran 0 tests.
- `scaffold-e2e.yml` has not run on the candidate sha; its latest scheduled run failed on `9112bcd8`.
- objectui live e2e is still red at its own pin `4016370a` (15 pass / 14 fail — the stale specs §2 names).

Part 2 (the gap-fill run's findings) follows when that run reports.

## Round 2 at `ba4afcc2` (part 2 of 2) — gap fill (partials + clause-free pins)

New records (each carries a `Carried-forward:` line per round-1 item; the round-1 record is closed `not_planned` with `Superseded-by:`): #24616 records-forms (38/44), #24604 studio-authoring (15/20), #24615 integration-system (17/20), #24612 dashboards (6/10), #24593 search (6/8), #24603 platform-core (27/34), #24601 access-security (31/35), #24596 automation (18/22), #24595 api-backend (22/27). approvals (#24542) and identity-auth (#24538) held only fixture-blocked clauses and were not re-run. `git diff 5b14b7f3 ba4afcc2 -- docs/qa/platform-checklist/` is empty, so every carried verdict is valid for the same item revision.

"The 9 Tier 1 items whose pin covers no full clause" (§0) were 8 in records-forms and 1 in integration-system; 7 of the records-forms ones now PASS hand-driven (`related-list-server-pagination`, `adhoc-filter-sort-builder`, `calendar-interactions`, `concurrent-edit-conflict`, `grid-personalization`, `lookup-picker-create-new`, `import-job-undo-cancel`).

New FAILs (all product defects, none P0, no authorization defect): `api-backend.aggregate-contract-matrix` negative[2] → #24618; `studio-authoring.expression-editors` negative[0], `records-forms.conditional-rules-grid` negative[1] (server half #24619 row a), `records-forms.action-location-matrix` acceptance[2] / negative[2] → objectstack-ai/objectui#13061, objectstack-ai/objectui#13062, objectstack-ai/objectui#13063 respectively (filed by the dispatch session on the runner's behalf).

### Re-point (add to §1 — red rows)

- `studio-authoring.expression-editors` acceptance[2] / acceptance[4] encode the editor's WARNING tier for a non-lowerable RLS predicate; the engine refuses it at ERROR tier (ADR-0056 D4) and negative[0] already says so. The clauses contradict each other — re-point acceptance[2] / [4] to the error tier.
- `approvals.email-action-token-door` (from #24620, the #24564 fix): the item captures live tokens from the stored reminder payload. After #24620 merges no reminder carries a link and no REST door mints a token, so its live mint leg becomes `blocked(fixture)` or moves to the pinned tests (`reminder-action-link-at-rest.integration.test.ts`, `sys-approval-token-generic-door.integration.test.ts`).

### Checklist-accuracy findings (add to §3)

- `api-backend.aggregate-contract-matrix`: the timezone lever is `POST /api/v1/analytics/query` (cube `showcase_delivery`, field `due_date`), not the `/data` door; negative[2] should state that a `date` dimension's labels are timezone-independent.
- `search.global-search-skips-unreadable`: step 5 needs `perObject=25`; the stock hidden field needs `role` = `user`.
- `access-security.sharing-rules-widen`: the oracle is the `sys_metadata_activation` row or a member's read — `/meta/sharing_rule` still reads `active: true` after the rule is switched off.
- `automation.trigger-status-contract`: the 409 `RESUME_IN_PROGRESS` arm reproduces reliably with a slow http node before the second screen.
- `automation.notify-inbox-delivery` knownGaps[2] is stale: app-todo with `--preset minimal`, requires automation + triggers + auth.
- `integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle`: the driver id is `mongodb`; the sqlite config key is `filename`; `POST /test`'s route registration order is the reverse of what its comment says.
- `integration-system.external-schema-introspection` knownGaps[0] is wrong — Postgres does not show `?schema=` narrowing either (#24619 row c).
- `integration-system.external-schema-browser-ui`: no entry from the Setup list (direct URL only); the "save first" branch is unreachable; the cited refusal copy is stale; a repeated import answers 201 and overwrites.
- `studio-authoring.metadata-diagnostics-sweep` knownGaps[0] is wrong — a scratch DB seed produces the invalid row.
- studio-authoring: the chip reads "Draft · N unpublished"; discarding a draft uses `?state=draft`.
- records-forms: `field-type-matrix` acceptance[1] needs re-scoping (no summary field on the zoo; autonumber is readonly); `related-list` knownGaps[0] and `v18-semantic-defaults` knownGaps[0] are stale; `list-view` negative[1] applies to tabs only; the invite-member recipe also needs accept-invitation; the console sends `filter` / `sort` / `top` without `$`; the calendar fallback recipe should reassign server-side mid-session; density has 3 modes; import Undo uses a native confirm; the record-discussion bell is driven by server notifications; `field-history` negative[0] should name the surface; `object-hook` acceptance[8] should state the expected envelope.
- dashboards: `dataset-report` negative[1]'s guard sits at publish, not draft save; reaching a 2020 window takes 79 clicks; the seed covers two months.

### Fixture gaps (add to §4)

- `records-forms.validation-rule-type-matrix` negative[0]: no way to author a non-evaluable CEL through the doors.
- platform-core / access-security partials that stay parked: `docs-audience-gate` acceptance[2] unreachable, no `^18` artefact, walled legs, the private RLS material, the guest anchor.
